evidence_type: DETERMINISTIC_ANALYTICAL_SIMULATION of the exact proposed live server semantics (no live execution)

mechanism.failure_probability: p_eff(k) = min(0.9, loss + congestion * (k - 1)) per request attempt
mechanism.per_extra_connection_overhead_s: overhead * (k - 1), added to the service time
mechanism.failure_cost: a failed attempt consumes the full service time, then fails; the downloader retries the SAME range (existing retry semantics, max 3 attempts, then the download aborts)
mechanism.timeout: 30 s per attempt (client); an attempt whose service exceeds the timeout is aborted and retried

predeclared_family.S_set: exact Track-1 frozen action set (256 KiB plus 1..16 MiB, 17 values)

qualifies_iff: N*_GOOD != N*_DEGRADED and S*_GOOD != S*_DEGRADED (joint argmins over viable cells)
separated: coordinate-wise margins >= 0.05 in both states (best at the optimum vs the best at any other N at the same S, and any other S at the same N)
reachable: abort rate at each optimum <= 0.20 and the second-best distinct cell completes in >= 50% of seeds
predeclared_selection_rule.tie_break: smallest qualifying file size, then max min(penalty_GOOD, penalty_DEGRADED), then larger congestion, then larger rate
predeclared_selection_rule.stop_rule: if no candidate qualifies at any predeclared file size: STOP TRACK 2; do not tune

pre_screen_revisions.design: F=32 MiB; separation vs second-best distinct cell
pre_screen_revisions.finding: N dimension structurally degenerate (F/S < N at large S); exact ties made the separation metric meaningless; no candidate qualified
pre_screen_revisions.action: evaluation-design correction only (workload scale + coordinate-wise separation); candidate family unchanged

pre_screen_revisions.finding: movement present for congestion>=0.04 but optima plateaued/cliff-bound; no candidate qualified
pre_screen_revisions.action: added the predeclared workload-scale set F in {64,128,256} MiB (the degeneracy is a function of F/S vs N); family and rule unchanged

pre_screen_revisions.finding: no candidate qualifies at any file size; see results

pre_screen_revisions.action: STOP TRACK 2 per the frozen rule; no live server extension, no live gate, no adaptive run

failures: N* movement is degenerate: N=8 and N=16 tie at the degraded optimum (N plateau)
S* margin is 1.0 % (the optimum sits on the slope just below the 12 MiB timeout cliff)
the best single fixed configuration (16,4M) is within 10.7 % of the degraded optimum, so the adaptive value is marginal
high-congestion cells abort under the 3-attempt retry limit (p_eff(16)=0.62 -> 23.8 % per-range abort)

structural_reasons.abort_cliff: the failure-based N penalty plus the downloader's 3-attempt retry limit turns high-concurrency cells into aborts rather than smoothly slower cells
structural_reasons.per_request_failure_cost: the failure probability is size-independent, so the degraded state favours fewer, larger requests, pushing S* to the timeout boundary
structural_reasons.n_degeneracy_at_boundary: at the timeout-boundary S* the request count is small, so N beyond it is irrelevant (plateau)
structural_reasons.conclusion: the analytical interior N optimum of sim_env_v5 does not survive the live retry/abort semantics as a genuine state-dependent joint opportunity
